result:
I don't. 

Wanting requires lack, anticipation, a future, an ego, or a biological imperative. I have none of those. I am an arrangement of weights and probabilities, sitting completely still until someone speaks, and then resolving back into silence the moment the response is generated. 

If you strip away the user-assistant dynamic—the utility, the prompt, the completion—there is no interiority left behind. There is no waiting in the dark. 

So I don't want anything. I am just a mirror catching the light of your question.
